notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content: [p]What a week! It's time for Jupiter Junkworks to get its first Steam update! Here comes Version 0.40.4![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Several Japanese localization fixes. ごめん！[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a major issue when accessing the menu when in certain dialogue sequences.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the gamepad cursor in menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Stopped gamepad cursor from double clicking, causing issues for rebinding.[/p][/*][*][p]Clearer instructions on continuing or skipping dialogue[/p][/*][*][p]Progress tracking moved to our non-demo version. This will fix a few issues but cause completion ticks (at least the ones that were working) to be reset. On the plus side, tracked high scores are in![/p][/*][*][p]Various Audio balancing adjustments.[/p][/*][*][p]New audio in the Comm Hub.[/p][/*][*][p]Ryla is working 5% harder, she's doing her best![/p][/*][*][p]Slight difficulty tuning.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a menu tablet distance option for easier reading, especially on handheld devices.[/p][/*][*][p]Jun is a little less sleepy.[/p][/*][*][p]A bunch of minor bug fixes. Mostly UI related stuff. Absolutely Grant's fault.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who has given the game a try. This is just a tiny little sample of what we have planned for the full game. We hope you enjoyed playing![/p]
